15    /**

17     *
18     * @return void
19     */
20    public static function bootHasGlobalScopes()
21    {

23    }

25    /**
26     * Resolve the global scope class names from the attributes.

28     * @return array
29     */
30    public static function resolveGlobalScopeAttributes()
31    {
32        $reflectionClass = new ReflectionClass(static::class);
33
34        return (new Collection($reflectionClass->getAttributes(ScopedBy::class)))
35            ->map(fn ($attribute) => $attribute->getArguments())
36            ->flatten()

40    /**
41     * Register a new global scope on the model.
42     *
43     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Scope|(\Closure(\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>): mixed)|string  $scope
44     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Scope|(\Closure(\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<static>): mixed)|null  $implementation
45     * @return mixed
46     *
47     * @throws \InvalidArgumentException
48     */
49    public static function addGlobalScope($scope, $implementation = null)
50    {
51        if (is_string($scope) && ($implementation instanceof Closure || $implementation instanceof Scope)) {
52            return static::$globalScopes[static::class][$scope] = $implementation;
53        } elseif ($scope instanceof Closure) {
54            return static::$globalScopes[static::class][spl_object_hash($scope)] = $scope;
55        } elseif ($scope instanceof Scope) {
56            return static::$globalScopes[static::class][get_class($scope)] = $scope;
57        } elseif (is_string($scope) && class_exists($scope) && is_subclass_of($scope, Scope::class)) {
58            return static::$globalScopes[static::class][$scope] = new $scope;

61        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Global scope must be an instance of Closure or Scope or be a class name of a class extending '.Scope::class);
